firm_data.firm_name: Cohen Clair Lans Greifer & Simpson LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Cohen Clair Lans Greifer & Simpson LLP is a New York City-based family law firm with a global reach, known for handling complex, high-profile divorce actions and other family law matters.
notable_facts: The firm handles billion and multi-billion dollar estates.
They have successfully tried some of the largest divorce cases in the U.S., including the largest equitable distribution case in New York State.
The firm is committed to undertaking a significant amount of pro bono work.

email.subject: AI for Cohen Clair Lans Greifer & Simpson LLP, built for firms handling billion-dollar estates
email.body:
Hi Shannon,

Your firm's track record handling billion and multi-billion dollar estates in complex divorce actions sets you apart. That scale demands precision tools that BigLaw has, but most platforms weren't built with firms like yours in mind.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of sophisticated practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
